title: Last Bell, 2007
logline: Ten years since his own. The strip draws the three on the steps — the ones from 1998 — as they'd be now, and gets them wrong on purpose.

panels.composition: Small Wood High, the last bell. Kids on the steps. WOOD across the road in the Datsun with BARNABY, drawing.

image.prompt: a small-town high school at the last bell seen from across the road, a man drawing inside an old Datsun with a dog, muddy flats

panels.composition: The pad: three figures on the steps, drawn as adults — a man in an overcoat, a woman with a Discman, a man in an apron — sitting where the kids are.
props: pad: three adults on school steps

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad showing three adults — a man in an overcoat, a woman with headphones, a man in a fisherman's apron — sitting on high school steps

panels.composition: Wood looking at it. Crossing out the overcoat. Drawing it again, smaller.

image.prompt: a man crossing out one figure on a drawing and redrawing it smaller, in a parked car

panels.composition: The steps, empty now, the kids gone to the beach. The Datsun pulling away. The pad on the seat: three adults on the steps, one small.

image.prompt: empty high school steps after the last bell, an old Datsun pulling away with a drawing pad visible on its seat, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: The three on the steps, aged, one redrawn small. Two-thirds, six months later, by choice.
